corrections: pat-amortised-dominance: the author's new monotonic-vs-heap paragraph said heaps are needed when there is 'no such dominance', citing 'the k-th largest value so far'; that case does have permanent discards (a size-k min-heap evicts losers forever). Rewritten: monotonic structures work when every removal happens at an end of arrival order; a heap or balanced tree is needed when the item to evict can sit anywhere in arrival order.
